title: cli/docs: `docs/metadata-embed-ref` judges every embed against the artifact's top level, so a multi-package artifact refuses each package doc's ```metadata embed, even one naming the package's own object
body:
## Source

hotcrm#2327 (PR hotcrm#2355) measured this on HotCRM, platform 18.2.0, while it wrote the in-app manuals. The report is hotcrm#2327 comment 6461000907, and the PR body records the probe.

A probe doc in the app package and one in the service package (`app.objectstack.hotcrm.service`) each carry a ```` ```metadata ```` `state_machine` embed of `crm_case`, an object the service package itself defines. `npx objectstack build`:

```
✗ Package docs validation failed (4 issues)
• docs/crm_probe_app: state_machine embed in "crm_probe_app" references object "crm_case", which does not exist in this package.
    rule: docs/metadata-embed-ref
• packages[0].docs/crm_probe_service: state_machine embed in "crm_probe_service" references object "crm_case", which does not exist in this package.
    rule: docs/metadata-embed-ref
```

## Mechanism (objectstack `main` `cbb3a1a1a`)

`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`:
- `:979` `lintMetadataEmbeds(docs, stack)` builds its object, flow and permission maps from `stack.objects`, `stack.flows` and `stack.permissions`.
- `:1365` judges the stack-level docs against the artifact `stack`.
- `:1372` judges each package's on-disk docs against the same artifact `stack` (`lintMetadataEmbeds(entry.fromDisk, stack)`), not against that package's body.

In a multi-package artifact (ADR-0130), the definitions live in `packages[i]`, so neither call finds them. The rule's own message says "does not exist in this package", and its docblock says references must resolve "within this stack". A package's own object fails that test.

## Effect

ADR-0051 embeds cannot be used in any multi-package artifact. HotCRM fell back to hand-written mermaid diagrams and a test that holds them to the compiled state machines (`test/docs-lifecycle-diagrams.test.ts`), which is what hotcrm#2327 allowed. It will swap them for embeds once the platform builds them.

## Target

Each package's docs are judged against that package's own body (`packages[i].objects / flows / permissions`). Stack-level docs are judged against the stack's own definitions, which also covers the definitions of a package that `claimedDocs` puts at the top level. Cross-package embeds stay out of v1 scope, as the docblock says.

## Acceptance

1. In a two-package artifact, a doc of package B with a `state_machine` embed of B's own object builds. A CLI test pins this.
2. The same embed in package A's doc, naming B's object, is still refused with `docs/metadata-embed-ref`.
3. A single-package stack is unmoved.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2327's report. Dedupe: searched open and closed objectstack issues for `metadata-embed-ref`, multi-package package docs embed and state_machine embed. #22190 (flat `src/docs` claimed by no package body) and #14512 / #14599 (multi-package serialization) are closed and cover different layers. No open card.</sub>
